project_name: Andover HPC Development 248 Stickles Pond Road Data Center
status_detail: Potential AI/HPC data center at the former Newton Airport/248 Stickles Pond Road site; reporting says no formal site plan had been filed as of May 2026. Andover later moved to prohibit data centers, and the developer reportedly sued over the ban.
notes: County/township source confirms Andover ordinance/redevelopment context; project details mainly from local/NJ.com reporting. Include as early/rejected lead because developer entity and parcel are named, but no formal land-use application was found.

status_detail: Kenilworth Planning Board approved Application #25-003 on May 15, 2025 to convert the NEST 11 lab building at 2000 Galloping Hill Road into a data center with generator and chiller yards; local news later reported construction and expected completion/operation in 2027.
notes: Official minutes identify CoreWeave Inc., Application #25-003, data center use, 24/7 operation, approximately 247,000 sq ft building conversion, 31 generators, 29 chillers, 4 water tanks, and unanimous approval. News sources describe the larger investment/schedule.

status_detail: Raton city commissioners approved a February 2026 MOU allowing Colorado-based Atterix to conduct a 6-month feasibility study. KOB reported phase 1 would convert an old Kmart into a data center using up to 5 MW, with later phases near a power station and airport bringing total potential use to 50 MW; city still needed to approve further development.
notes: No county permit found; project is at feasibility/MOU stage and may be inside City of Raton jurisdiction. County-level searches also found discussion of controls/moratoriums but no final county approval.
